tasks.name: 创建笔记模型
tasks.description:
在 app/models/ 目录下创建 Note 模型。修改 app/models/__init__.py 添加导入。模型字段: id, title, content, created_at。

API Specification (ALL TASKS MUST USE SAME API):
- POST /notes (request: {title: str, content: str}) -> {id, title, content, created_at}
- GET /notes -> [{id, title, content, created_at}]
- GET /notes/search (request: {query: str}) -> [{id, title, content, created_at}]

tasks.name: 创建笔记API
tasks.description:
在 app/routes/ 目录下创建 notes.py 路由文件。提供 CRUD API 和搜索功能。需要在 app/__init__.py 注册 notes_bp 蓝图。

API Specification (ALL TASKS MUST USE SAME API):
- POST /notes (request: {title: str, content: str}) -> {id, title, content, created_at}
- GET /notes -> [{id, title, content, created_at}]
- GET /notes/search (request: {query: str}) -> [{id, title, content, created_at}]

tasks.name: 创建笔记前端页面
tasks.description:
在 templates/ 目录下创建 notes.html 前端页面，用于显示和搜索笔记。需要在 app/__init__.py 添加路由来显示这个页面（如 @app.route('/notes')）。

API Specification (ALL TASKS MUST USE SAME API):
- POST /notes (request: {title: str, content: str}) -> {id, title, content, created_at}
- GET /notes -> [{id, title, content, created_at}]
- GET /notes/search (request: {query: str}) -> [{id, title, content, created_at}]

tasks.name: 创建笔记组织功能
tasks.description:
在 app/models/ 目录下扩展 Note 模型，添加分类字段 category。修改 app/routes/notes.py 添加分类相关的 API。需要在 app/__init__.py 注册更新后的蓝图。

API Specification (ALL TASKS MUST USE SAME API):
- POST /notes (request: {title: str, content: str, category: str}) -> {id, title, content, category, created_at}
- GET /notes -> [{id, title, content, category, created_at}]
- GET /notes/search (request: {query: str}) -> [{id, title, content, category, created_at}]

tasks.name: 创建笔记搜索前端页面
tasks.description:
在 templates/ 目录下扩展 notes.html，添加搜索功能的前端支持。需要在 app/__init__.py 添加搜索相关的路由。

API Specification (ALL TASKS MUST USE SAME API):
- POST /notes (request: {title: str, content: str}) -> {id, title, content, created_at}
- GET /notes -> [{id, title, content, created_at}]
- GET /notes/search (request: {query: str}) -> [{id, title, content, created_at}]

T1.implementation_approach: Design a database schema for notes with fields like title, content, timestamp, and tags, and implement it using an ORM or database queries.
T1.notes: Ensure scalability and support for future features like categorization or sharing.

T2.implementation_approach: Develop RESTful API endpoints for creating, reading, updating, and deleting notes, ensuring proper validation and authentication.
T2.notes: Use a framework like Flask or Express for quick development.

T3.implementation_approach: Build a responsive front-end page using a framework like React or Vue to display, create, and edit notes.
T3.notes: Focus on user-friendly design and seamless integration with the API.

T4.implementation_approach: Implement a feature to organize notes into folders or categories, with options to sort and filter them.
T4.notes: Consider adding drag-and-drop functionality for better user experience.

T5.implementation_approach: Create a search interface on the front-end with a search bar and filters, and connect it to a back-end search API.
T5.notes: Optimize the search functionality for speed and accuracy, possibly using indexing.
